title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 203 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 203 - Investigation of Source of Income If an Income-tax authority considers it necessary for any inquiry investigation or running investigation proceedings pending under this Act, may investigate any information relating to the source of income of any person concerned with such proceedings and compel to collect or supply copies of information and records relating to the source of income. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
